purpose: Define cross-module formal invariants, dependency order, and failure propagation rules before creating package code.

external_anchors.used_for: Grid schema dialect and validator terminology.
Constraint-propagation reference for local grid coherence.
License-expression syntax and case-sensitive operator gate.
Canonical license identifier and exception reference.

formal_symbols.C: generated candidate with grid, lineage, and trace metadata
formal_symbols.F: fitness vector or scalar comparator value

admissibility_chain: generation may use G as parent
archive may derive D and F from C and E
provenance R must be ok before package promotion
genome may produce render packet from accepted G or C.grid

requirements: Draft 2020-12 compatible grid schema
cell coordinates within declared bounds
unique occupied coordinates
known semantic roles
bounded mutation weights
body mass within accepted range
connected occupied body when one-body profile requires it
sensor and animation-anchor requirements enforced
organ memberships reference existing occupied cells
palette and render packet constraints satisfiable
invalid parents rejected by generation
invalid grids rejected before lifecycle simulation
invalid candidates rejected before archive insertion
invalid grids cannot produce renderability claims
mutation weights bounded
lifecycle state values finite
fitness components bounded and JSON-serializable
SLIP alignment values bounded
archive descriptors deterministic bins
deterministic outputs reproduce under same declared seed and inputs
stochastic outputs preserve seed or random-source metadata
caller-provided grids are not mutated
caller-provided profiles are not mutated
caller-provided candidates, episode results, and archive states are not mutated unless documented as in-place APIs
parent ID or null seed origin preserved
generator name preserved
generator version or gate status preserved
random seed preserved when used
SLIP profile ID preserved when used
validation status preserved
rejected proposal count preserved when generation filters candidates
lifecycle episode configuration preserved
archive descriptor key and fitness components preserved
provenance decision references preserved when assets or licenses are involved
descriptor keys deterministic
elite replacement only when candidate beats current elite for same descriptor key
coverage and QD score reportable
scalar top-k remains comparator/debug view only
human-calibrated readability descriptors blocked until reviewer data exists

blocked_states: final archive descriptor thresholds claiming human calibration without reviewer data
real CuBFF adoption without official or local real snapshot artifacts
online reward-shaping promotion until it beats frozen baseline under dynamic stress
release license metadata until package exists and license decision records are explicit

requirements: package runtime code does not import labs
package tests do not import labs
package tests do not mutate sys.path to reach labs
package imports do not write Stage 0 artifacts
package outputs remain JSON-serializable where report contracts require them
package-promotion checks rerun after package tests exist

failure_propagation_rules.required_propagation: Reject parent, candidate, lifecycle simulation, archive insertion, and render packet until fresh validation passes.
Reject profile-constrained generation and profile-weighted lifecycle use; no implicit fallback profile unless explicit in result.
Keep candidate in rejection trace only; do not score it as lifecycle or archive candidate.
Reject episode; archive may not derive descriptor or fitness from it.
Block human-calibrated descriptor claim; use only non-human descriptors.
Block package promotion even if package tests pass.
Do not run package tests or claim package readiness; continue research-only gates.

evidence_required_before_package_promoti.slip_constrained_generation_required: 50/50 valid and aligned or stricter superseding evidence
evidence_required_before_package_promoti.lifecycle_required: finite bounded episode summaries for frozen comparator scenarios
evidence_required_before_package_promoti.archive_required: descriptor coverage, elite replacement, and QD-score evidence through package imports
evidence_required_before_package_promoti.provenance_required: SPDX expression parsing and included/reference-only distinction
evidence_required_before_package_promoti.boundary_required: no lab imports, no package-test sys.path mutation, no import-time artifact writes

negative_checks: downstream module accepts invalid grid because it looks visually plausible
generator reports only successful candidates and drops rejected proposals without trace metadata
lifecycle clips non-finite or out-of-range values without reporting correction
archive replacement becomes scalar top-k selection
package docs claim full WFC CTM CuBFF NCA or online-learning adoption beyond tested contract
provenance accepts lowercase SPDX operators as equivalent to AND OR WITH
package code or tests import labs
package marked promotion-ready before promotion gate rerun
decision_rule: No future package module may consume, promote, archive, render, or release a state that has not passed the upstream invariant gate required by its input.
next_research_step: Use this gate when converting package contract obligations into concrete package tests after the user explicitly starts package implementation.
